title: This query will show you which grades in your GRD table are also missing credits
description: This query will show you which grades in your GRD table are also missing credits
code: LIST STU GRD CRS STU.ID STU.NM STU.GR? GRD.PD GRD.CN CRS.CO GRD.TN GRD.MK GRD.M1 GRD.M2 GRD.M3 GRD.CR GRD.TM GRD.SE IF GRD.CR = 0
